obernants.operator: For fixed concepts/links, U consists of valid lexical/path requests paired with typed results; R follows has_word, sense selection and BFS/chain rules in this range. U\R excludes a longer-than-shortest BFS witness, a category-start consequence and a >8-link consequence. These are sound intended restrictions of the specification; actual correspondence is unproved.
